description: AEXCID A.7 Technical and professional services without an employment relationship: repair and maintenance of vehicles, generators and equipment (réparation, entretien, vidange, main d'oeuvre, forfait main d'oeuvre, garage, spare parts fitted during a repair), consultancy, technical assistance, training and seminar organisation (formation), studies, reports, publications, design and layout, printing/photocopying, audiovisual and security services. Not purchases of goods (EQUIPOS/CONSUMIBLES); identification, works and audit services go to their own lines.
